intro: "Speak with Deino" is a summons directing promising Horde mages to seek out a skilled practitioner in Orgrimmar. Deino, a troll mage operating out of the Valley of Spirits, requires an adept to undertake critical work on behalf of their craft. Answering her call opens the path to deeper magical study and vital tasks across Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The troll mage Deino has need of your assistance, friend. She resides in Orgrimmar, in the Darkbriar Lodge.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good, you have come. My task is not an easy one, but vital to the society of mages. If you aid me, I am sure you will find it worthwhile.
